items.summary: Olmo is a series of Open language models designed to enable the science of language models. These models are pre-trained on the Dolma 3 dataset and post-trained on the Dolci datasets.

items.name: olmo-3.1
items.summary: Olmo is a series of Open language models designed to enable the science of language models. These models are pre-trained on the Dolma 3 dataset and post-trained on the Dolci datasets.

items.name: olmo2
items.summary: OLMo 2 is a new family of 7B and 13B models trained on up to 5T tokens. These models are on par with or better than equivalently sized fully open models, and competitive with open-weight models such as Llama 3.1 on English academic benchmarks.

items.name: open-orca-platypus2
items.summary: Merge of the Open Orca OpenChat model and the Garage-bAInd Platypus 2 model. Designed for chat and code generation.

items.name: openchat
items.summary: A family of open-source models trained on a wide variety of data, surpassing ChatGPT on various benchmarks. Updated to version 3.5-0106.

items.name: opencoder
items.summary: OpenCoder is an open and reproducible code LLM family which includes 1.5B and 8B models, supporting chat in English and Chinese languages.

items.name: openhermes
items.summary: OpenHermes 2.5 is a 7B model fine-tuned by Teknium on Mistral with fully open datasets.

items.name: openthinker
items.summary: A fully open-source family of reasoning models built using a dataset derived by distilling DeepSeek-R1.

items.name: orca-mini
items.summary: A general-purpose model ranging from 3 billion parameters to 70 billion, suitable for entry-level hardware.

items.name: orca2
items.summary: Orca 2 is built by Microsoft research, and are a fine-tuned version of Meta's Llama 2 models. The model is designed to excel particularly in reasoning.

items.name: ornith
items.summary: A self-improving family of open-source models for agentic coding

items.name: ornith-1.5
items.summary: Chirp Chirp! We are introducing Ornith-1.5, a major step toward building foundation models through end-to-end self-improvement.

items.name: paraphrase-multilingual
items.summary: Sentence-transformers model that can be used for tasks like clustering or semantic search.

items.name: phi
items.summary: Phi-2: a 2.7B language model by Microsoft Research that demonstrates outstanding reasoning and language understanding capabilities.

items.name: phi3
items.summary: Phi-3 is a family of lightweight 3B (Mini) and 14B (Medium) state-of-the-art open models by Microsoft.

items.name: phi3.5
items.summary: A lightweight AI model with 3.8 billion parameters with performance overtaking similarly and larger sized models.

items.name: phi4
items.summary: Phi-4 is a 14B parameter, state-of-the-art open model from Microsoft.

items.name: phi4-mini
items.summary: Phi-4-mini brings significant enhancements in multilingual support, reasoning, and mathematics, and now, the long-awaited function calling feature is finally supported.

items.name: phi4-mini-reasoning
items.summary: Phi 4 mini reasoning is a lightweight open model that balances efficiency with advanced reasoning ability.

items.name: phi4-reasoning
items.summary: Phi 4 reasoning and reasoning plus are 14-billion parameter open-weight reasoning models that rival much larger models on complex reasoning tasks.

items.name: phind-codellama
items.summary: Code generation model based on Code Llama.

items.name: phonon
items.summary: Phonon is Gradium’s text-to-speech family. It turns written text into spoken audio as it generates, making it useful for reading assistant replies, narrating passages, and adding a voice to local apps.

items.name: pplx-decider
items.summary: pplx-decider is a 27B decision model from Perplexity, fine-tuned from Qwen3.8-27B

items.name: qwen
items.summary: Qwen 1.5 is a series of large language models by Alibaba Cloud spanning from 0.5B to 110B parameters

items.name: qwen2
items.summary: Qwen2 is a new series of large language models from Alibaba group

items.name: qwen2-math
items.summary: Qwen2 Math is a series of specialized math language models built upon the Qwen2 LLMs, which significantly outperforms the mathematical capabilities of open-source models and even closed-source models (e.g., GPT4o).

items.name: qwen2.5
items.summary: Qwen2.5 models are pretrained on Alibaba's latest large-scale dataset, encompassing up to 18 trillion tokens. The model supports up to 128K tokens and has multilingual support.

items.name: qwen2.5-coder
items.summary: The latest series of Code-Specific Qwen models, with significant improvements in code generation, code reasoning, and code fixing.

items.name: qwen2.5vl
items.summary: Flagship vision-language model of Qwen and also a significant leap from the previous Qwen2-VL.

items.name: qwen3
items.summary: Qwen3 is the latest generation of large language models in Qwen series, offering a comprehensive suite of dense and mixture-of-experts (MoE) models.

items.name: qwen3-coder
items.summary: Alibaba's performant long context models for agentic and coding tasks.

items.name: qwen3-coder-next
items.summary: Qwen3-Coder-Next is a coding-focused language model from Alibaba's Qwen team, optimized for agentic coding workflows and local development.

items.name: qwen3-embedding
items.summary: Building upon the foundational models of the Qwen3 series, Qwen3 Embedding provides a comprehensive range of text embeddings models in various sizes

items.name: qwen3-next
items.summary: The first installment in the Qwen3-Next series with strong performance in terms of both parameter efficiency and inference speed.

items.name: qwen3-vl
items.summary: The most powerful vision-language model in the Qwen model family to date.

items.name: qwen3.5
items.summary: Qwen 3.5 is a family of open-source multimodal models that delivers exceptional utility and performance.

items.name: qwen3.6
items.summary: Qwen3.6 delivers substantial upgrades in agentic coding and thinking preservation than previous Qwen models.

items.name: qwen3.8
items.summary: Qwen3.8 delivers substantial gains across coding, professional work, research, and long-horizon agentic tasks.

items.name: qwen3.8-flash-next
items.summary: This experimental preview of the architecture that will underpin Qwen4.

items.name: qwq

items.name: reader-lm
items.summary: A series of models that convert HTML content to Markdown content, which is useful for content conversion tasks.

items.name: reflection
items.summary: A high-performing model trained with a new technique called Reflection-tuning that teaches a LLM to detect mistakes in its reasoning and correct course.

items.name: rnj-1

items.name: sailor2

items.name: samantha-mistral
items.summary: A companion assistant trained in philosophy, psychology, and personal relationships. Based on Mistral.

items.name: shieldgemma

items.name: smallthinker
items.summary: A new small reasoning model fine-tuned from the Qwen 2.5 3B Instruct model.

items.name: smollm
items.summary: A family of small models with 135M, 360M, and 1.7B parameters, trained on a new high-quality dataset.

items.name: smollm2
items.summary: SmolLM2 is a family of compact language models available in three size: 135M, 360M, and 1.7B parameters.

items.name: snowflake-arctic-embed
items.summary: A suite of text embedding models by Snowflake, optimized for performance.

items.name: snowflake-arctic-embed2
items.summary: Snowflake's frontier embedding model. Arctic Embed 2.0 adds multilingual support without sacrificing English performance or scalability.

items.name: solar
items.summary: A compact, yet powerful 10.7B large language model designed for single-turn conversation.

items.name: solar-pro

items.name: sqlcoder

items.name: stablelm-zephyr

items.name: stablelm2

items.name: starcoder

items.name: starcoder2

items.name: starling-lm

items.name: tev1

items.name: tinydolphin

items.name: translategemma

items.name: wizardcoder
items.summary: State-of-the-art code generation model

items.name: wizardlm
items.summary: General use model based on Llama 2.

items.name: wizardlm-uncensored

items.name: wizardlm2
items.summary: State of the art large language model from Microsoft AI with improved performance on complex chat, multilingual, reasoning and agent use cases.

items.name: xwinlm
items.summary: Conversational model based on Llama 2 that performs competitively on various benchmarks.

items.name: yarn-mistral
items.summary: An extension of Mistral to support context windows of 64K or 128K.

items.name: yi

items.name: yi-coder
